errors.text_span: с равномерно разпределени етикети за всяка година
errors.evidence: The labels on the x-axis are not present for every year; the label for 2012 is missing.
The chart does not have minor gridlines for every 1%; the only gridlines are at 5% intervals.
The description generally states that each line is marked with a marker, but none of the lines in the chart have markers.
The description incorrectly states that the line for ЦКБ has round markers. This error is repeated for all six banks, which do not have any markers.

errors.text_span: пада до около 6% през 2011 г., след което се възстановява до около 9% през 2013 г.
errors.evidence: The description of the trend for Инвест банк is incorrect. The line does not fall to 6%; its lowest point is around 8% in 2017. Its peak in 2013 is at approximately 11.5%, not 9%.
The color description 'сиво-сиво' (grey-grey) is redundant and awkward.
The line for Общинска банка never drops below 5%. It stays within the range of approximately 5.5% to 6.5%.

errors.text_span: започва при около 12% през 2008 г., пада до около 7% през 2011 г., след което се възстановява до около 9% през 2013 г.
errors.evidence: The entire description of the historical trend for Интернешънъл Асет Банк is incorrect. It starts at ~9% (not 12%), its lowest point is ~8% in 2018 (not 7% in 2011), and its major peak is in 2009 at ~12.5% (not 9% in 2013).

errors.text_span: пада до около 10% през 2011 г., след което се възстановява до около 13% през 2014 г.
errors.evidence: The description of the trend for Д Банк is incorrect. The line's lowest point is around 8% in 2014, not 10% in 2011. In 2014, the line is at its lowest point, not recovering to 13%.
The line for Тексим банк stabilizes at a value of approximately 16%, not in a range up to 18%.
